places.name: Blue Lagoon (Emerald Waters)
places.ai_summary: A stunning natural lagoon with emerald green waters, perfect for swimming and relaxing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a boat ride to explore the lagoon fully.

places.name: Frenchman’s Cove Beach
places.ai_summary: A picturesque beach with a river flowing into the sea, offering a unique blend of fresh and saltwater.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during weekdays to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the serene environment.

places.name: Reach Falls
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located in the hills of Portland, offering a refreshing escape and natural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available and recommended.

places.place_tip: Wear water shoes for better grip on the rocks.

places.name: Boston Bay (Jerk Capital of Jamaica)
places.ai_summary: Famous for its jerk cuisine, this area offers a cultural and culinary experience by the beach.

opening_hours.notes: Try to visit during the day for a full experience.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the jerk chicken and pork.

places.name: Navy Island (Private Excursions)
places.ai_summary: A private island offering exclusive tours, beautiful beaches, and a glimpse into the luxurious side of Port Antonio.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is essential.

places.place_tip: Explore the entire island and enjoy a beachside lunch.

places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes and a waterproof camera.

places.ai_summary: The ruins of a historic mansion set in beautiful gardens, offering a glimpse into the past and stunning views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guide for historical context.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the coastal views.

places.name: Winifred Beach
places.ai_summary: A beautiful public beach known for its clear waters and relaxed atmosphere, great for families.

opening_hours.notes: Get there early to secure a good spot.

places.place_tip: Try the local food vendors for a taste of authentic Jamaican cuisine.

places.name: Somerset Falls
places.ai_summary: A stunning waterfall and natural pool, ideal for a refreshing swim and enjoying nature.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available and recommended.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the beautiful scenery.

places.name: Errol Flynn Marina
places.ai_summary: A popular marina in Port Antonio, known for its vibrant atmosphere and as a starting point for boat tours.

opening_hours.notes: Check for boat tour availability and timings.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at the marina restaurant for fresh seafood.

places.name: Monkey Island (Kayak Spot)
places.ai_summary: A small island accessible by kayak, offering a unique perspective of Port Antonio's coastline and marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with your own kayak or on a guided tour.

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the underwater life.

places.name: Trident Castle
places.ai_summary: A stunning castle located on the cliffs of Port Antonio, offering breathtaking views and a glimpse into the luxurious past.

places.name: San San Beach
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and relatively secluded beach, perfect for a relaxing day in the sun.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own food and drinks as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby coral reefs if you enjoy snorkeling.
places.address: San San Beach, Port Antonio, Jamaica

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and try the local street food.

places.name: Port Antonio Parish Church
places.ai_summary: A historic church in the heart of Port Antonio, known for its beautiful architecture and serene surroundings.
